title: Roblox target-device performance validation
summary: A production capability for evaluating an experience on representative hardware and preserving measurable performance evidence.

designKnowledge.targetTier: The approved minimum certified tier is midrange mobile plus desktop. Actual device models and numeric budgets must be selected and recorded from available hardware.
designKnowledge.qualityTiers: Lower tiers may reduce geometry, texture resolution, effects, and environmental complexity while preserving silhouette, readability, visual identity, and gameplay.

technicalPatterns.name: Profile representative scenarios
technicalPatterns.guidance: Measure onboarding, the densest environment, peak gameplay, transitions, and low-memory behavior on named devices; record build, scenario, duration, settings, and output.

technicalPatterns.name: Keep device evidence reproducible
technicalPatterns.guidance: Record hardware and OS, Studio/engine version, place/build identity, quality setting, test scenario, and measurements.

failureModes.description: A desktop run is used to infer mobile frame time, memory, or readability.
failureModes.mitigation: Require evidence from the named midrange mobile baseline and desktop separately.

failureModes.description: Performance reduction removes essential silhouettes or navigation cues.
failureModes.mitigation: Run matched readability and visual identity checks across device tiers.

scenarios.action: Run a representative peak gameplay scenario on the named midrange mobile device.
scenarios.expected: Measured frame time, memory, join behavior, and visual readability meet declared project thresholds.

scenarios.action: Repeat the scenario on the named desktop profile.
scenarios.expected: Desktop results are recorded separately and do not replace mobile evidence.

acceptanceCriteria: Device models and project-specific thresholds are recorded.
Mobile and desktop evidence are independent.

considerations: This record defines the profiling discipline; it contains no universal frame or memory threshold.
Compare measurements against experience-specific targets and named hardware.

sourceRefs.title: Approved Lab minimum certified device tier

evidence.description: Device-specific profiling and identity-preserving quality-tier requirements are defined.

assumptions: Actual target devices and quantitative thresholds remain to be recorded from available hardware.
This design record does not claim that a device profile has been run.
